editorial:
You follow Joy, a hardworking Long Island single mom who is juggling a messy family, a broken marriage, and a house full of chaos. She has always been the one holding everyone together, but her own dreams keep getting pushed aside. When she invents a self-wringing mop, she finally sees a chance to build something for herself. The movie has a warm, scrappy energy that makes you root for her from the start. Jennifer Lawrence carries the whole story with a grounded, believable performance that feels real rather than flashy.

The pacing moves quickly, jumping between family drama and business struggles, and the supporting cast adds plenty of color. Some scenes feel a little messy, and the tone shifts between comedy and drama can be jarring, but the heart of the story never fades. If you enjoy underdog tales about ordinary people chasing big dreams, this one is for you. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: Joy finally breaks free from her controlling family and business partners. She confronts the company that tried to steal her patent and wins back control of her invention. In the final scenes, she is shown years later as a successful businesswoman running her own empire, having built a life on her own terms. The twist is that the people who doubted her end up working for her, and she learns that trusting herself was the real key to her success.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves inspiring true stories about everyday people chasing big dreams.
